name: Korean
era: Goguryeo tomb murals (c. 5th c.) - Joseon (Cheonsang Yeolcha Bunyajido, 1395)
description: The Korean form of the Chinese star system: Three Palaces (enclosures), Twenty-Eight Mansions (isipalsu) and the Four Symbols, with Korean readings of the Hanja names.

figures.name: Azure Dragon of the East
figures.group: Four Symbols
figures.story: One of the Four Symbols (sixiang); it governs seven of the Twenty-Eight Mansions: Horn, Neck, Root, Room, Heart, Tail, Winnowing Basket. Lines shown are the union of those seven mansion asterisms (derived, not a separate historical star pattern).

figures.name: Black Tortoise of the North
figures.group: Four Symbols
figures.story: One of the Four Symbols (sixiang); it governs seven of the Twenty-Eight Mansions: South Dipper, Leading Ox, Labor Woman, Emptiness, Rooftop, Encampment, Eastern Wall. Lines shown are the union of those seven mansion asterisms (derived, not a separate historical star pattern).

figures.name: White Tiger of the West
figures.group: Four Symbols
figures.story: One of the Four Symbols (sixiang); it governs seven of the Twenty-Eight Mansions: Legs, Bond, Stomach, Hairy Head, Net, Turtle Beak, Three Stars. Lines shown are the union of those seven mansion asterisms (derived, not a separate historical star pattern).

figures.name: Vermilion Bird of the South
figures.group: Four Symbols
figures.story: One of the Four Symbols (sixiang); it governs seven of the Twenty-Eight Mansions: East Well, Ghosts, Willow, Star, Extended Net, Wings, Chariot. Lines shown are the union of those seven mansion asterisms (derived, not a separate historical star pattern).

figures.name: Northern Pole
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Northern Pole (Korean: 북극, Hanja: 北極, Romanization: Bukgeuk) consists of 5 stars in the central part of the Purple Forbidden Enclosure. It is one of the most important constellations in Chinese star culture. The five stars are Crown Prince (γ UMi), Emperor (β UMi), Bastard (4 UMi), Harem (3 UMi), and Northern Pole star (HIP 62572, also known as Celestial Pivot or Ancient Star).

figures.name: Four Advisors
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Four Advisors (Korean: 사보, Hanja: 四輔, Romanization: Sabo) consists of 4 stars surrounding the Northern Pole star (HIP 62572). They represent four auxiliary ministers assisting the Northern Pole.

figures.name: Celestial One
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Celestial Great One (Korean: 천일, Hanja: 天一, Romanization: Cheon-il) is 1 star outside the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, south of the right star of the palace gate. It is the god of the Heavenly Emperor, governing the operation of the Heavenly Tao, coordinating the twelve divine generals, and presiding over wars and personal good fortune.

figures.name: Supreme One
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: First Great One (Korean: 태일, Hanja: 太一, Romanization: Taeil) is 1 star south of Celestial Great One, close to it. It governs the sixteen gods and is responsible for predicting natural disasters and social upheavals such as wind, rain, floods, droughts, wars, famines, and plagues.

figures.name: Purple Forbidden Palace
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Purple Forbidden Enclosure (Korean: 자미, Hanja: 紫微, Romanization: Jami) is the place where the Heavenly Emperor resides and discusses affairs with close ministers.

figures.name: Purple Forbidden Palace
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Purple Forbidden Palace, an East Asian star official as identified in Stellarium's Korean sky culture.

figures.name: Hidden Virtue
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Hidden Virtue (Korean: 음덕, Hanja: 陰德, Romanization: Eumdeok) consists of 2 stars inside the Purple Forbidden Enclosure gate, west of the Royal Secretary. It refers to good deeds done in secret, in charge of benefiting the people and providing relief and comfort.

figures.name: Royal Secretary
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Royal Secretary (Korean: 상서, Hanja: 尚書, Romanization: Sangseo) consists of 5 stars in the southeast corner of the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, inside the south gate. It is an official responsible for documents and memorials, offering advice to the Heavenly Emperor.

figures.name: Female Protocol
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Female Protocol (Korean: 여사, Hanja: 女史, Romanization: Yeosa) is 1 star north of the Official of Royal Archives. It is a female official in charge of timekeeping by water clock in the palace.

figures.name: Official of Royal Archives
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Official of Royal Archives (Korean: 주하사, Hanja: 柱下史, Romanization: Juhasa) is 1 star northeast of the Northern Pole, close to the Royal Secretary. It is a historian responsible for recording daily affairs in the palace.

figures.name: Palace of the Maids-in-waiting
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Maids-in-waiting (Korean: 여어궁, Hanja: 女御宮, Romanization: Yeoeogung) consists of 4 stars north of the Curved Array, serving as maids in the palace.

figures.name: Celestial Pillar
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Celestial Pillar (Korean: 천주, Hanja: 天柱, Romanization: Cheonju) consists of 5 stars near the Purple Forbidden East Wall, close to the northern end of the wall. They are pillars in the Heavenly Palace used for posting decrees. Bans are often issued here at the beginning and middle of the month to notify all officials.

figures.name: Chief Judge
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Chief Judge (Korean: 대리, Hanja: 大理, Romanization: Daeri) consists of 2 stars inside the left star of the Purple Forbidden Enclosure gate, close to Hidden Virtue. It is an official in charge of trial and punishment, used for divining wrongful convictions.

figures.name: Curved Array
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Curved Array (Korean: 구진, Hanja: 勾陳, Romanization: Gujin) consists of 6 stars in the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, arranged like a hook. It represents the Emperor's harem, with the brightest star α UMi representing the primary consort.

figures.name: Six Jia
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Six Jia (Korean: 육갑, Hanja: 六甲, Romanization: Yukgap) consists of 6 stars in the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, beside the Canopy of the Emperor and Canopy Support. Six Jia refers to the six Heavenly Stems paired with "Jia", including Jiazi, Jiaxu, Jiashen, Jiawu, Jiachen, and Jiayin. Heavenly Stems and Earthly Branches are important timekeeping units in China, also commonly used for counting, naming, and divination.

figures.name: Great Emperor of Heaven
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Great Emperor of Heaven (Korean: 천황대제, Hanja: 天皇大帝, Romanization: Cheonhwangdaeje) is 1 star in the mouth of the Curved Array. In Taoism, the Heavenly Emperor is also known as the Hook Array Emperor because of its location in the Curved Array.

figures.name: Seats of the Five Emperors
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Interior Seats of the Five Emperors (Korean: 오제좌, Hanja: 五帝坐, Romanization: Ojejwa) consists of 5 stars under the Canopy of the Emperor, beside the Canopy Support. They are the seats of the Five Emperors of the five directions. The Five Emperors include the Green Emperor, Red Emperor, Yellow Emperor, White Emperor, and Black Emperor, corresponding to the east, south, center, west, and north directions respectively.

figures.name: Canopy of the Emperor
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Canopy of the Emperor (Korean: 화개, Hanja: 華蓋, Romanization: Hwagae) consists of 7 stars above the Great Emperor of Heaven, at the back gate of the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, just covering the Great Emperor of Heaven. It is the umbrella used by the Emperor.

figures.name: Canopy Support (Vassal of Canopy of the Emperor)
figures.meaning: Canopy Support (Vassal of Canopy of the Emperor)
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Canopy Support (Korean: 강, Hanja: 杠, Romanization: Gang) consists of 9 stars under the Canopy of the Emperor, serving as the handle of the canopy.

figures.name: Guest House
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Guest House (Korean: 전사, Hanja: 傳舍, Romanization: Jeonsa) consists of 9 stars outside the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, above the Canopy of the Emperor, close to the Milky Way. It is a place for guests to stay.

figures.name: Inner Steps
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Inner Steps (Korean: 내계, Hanja: 內階, Romanization: Naegye) consists of 6 stars north of the Administrative Center, the steps for the Heavenly Emperor to go up and down, connecting the back gate of the Purple Forbidden Enclosure with the Administrative Center.

figures.name: Celestial Kitchen
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Celestial Kitchen (Korean: 천주, Hanja: 天厨, Romanization: Cheonju) consists of 6 stars outside the northeast corner of the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, the kitchen responsible for state banquet catering.

figures.name: Eight Kinds of Crops
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Eight Kinds of Crops (Korean: 팔곡, Hanja: 八穀, Romanization: Palgok) consists of 8 stars north of the Five Chariots, in front of the Inner Steps. The eight kinds of grain crops are rice, millet, barley, wheat, soybeans, small beans, millet, and hemp. They are used for divining agricultural harvests.

figures.name: Celestial Flail
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Celestial Flail (Korean: 천봉, Hanja: 天棓, Romanization: Cheonbong) consists of 5 stars northeast of the Woman's Bed, a big stick, like the Celestial Spear, also a defensive weapon.

figures.name: Celestial Bed
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Celestial Bed (Korean: 천상, Hanja: 天床, Romanization: Cheonsang) consists of 6 stars outside the Purple Forbidden Enclosure gate. It is the bed where the Heavenly Emperor sleeps and rests.

figures.name: Inner Kitchen
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Inner Kitchen (Korean: 내주, Hanja: 內厨, Romanization: Naeju) consists of 2 stars outside the southwest corner of the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, the kitchen responsible for the palace's diet.

figures.name: Administrative Center
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Administrative Center (Korean: 문창, Hanja: 文昌, Romanization: Munchang) consists of 6 stars in front of the bowl of the Northern Dipper (the Big Dipper), west of the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, shaped like a half-moon and a basket, known as "the dipper wearing a basket". It is a collective name for six government departments or officials, including the Great General, Second General, Distinguished Premier, Deified Judge of Life, Deified Judge of Central Affairs, and Deified Judge of Rank, in charge of cultural education, etiquette and music, rewarding and punishing officials, adding salaries, and promoting officials to higher positions.

figures.name: Three Excellencies (Wuxian)
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Three Top Instructors (Korean: 삼공, Hanja: 三公, Romanization: Samgong) consists of 3 stars west of the first star (α UMa) of the bowl of the Northern Dipper. The Three Top Instructors are the Grand Protector, Grand Tutor, and Grand Preceptor, the highest officials responsible for national military and political affairs.

figures.name: Royals
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Royals (Korean: 태존, Hanja: 太尊, Romanization: Taejon) is 1 star north of the Middle Step. It represents royal relatives.

figures.name: Celestial Prison
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Celestial Prison (Korean: 천뢰, Hanja: 天牢, Romanization: Cheolloe) consists of 6 stars under the bowl of Northern Dipper, a prison for detaining law-breaking nobles.

figures.name: Guard of the Sun
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Guard of the Sun (Korean: 태양수, Hanja: 太陽守, Romanization: Taeyangsu) is 1 star southwest of the Prime Minister. It is a general responsible for garrison and alert.

figures.name: Eunuch
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Eunuch (Korean: 세, Hanja: 勢, Romanization: Se) consists of 4 stars northwest of the Guard of the Sun, officials who have been castrated, specifically eunuchs.

figures.name: Prime Minister
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Prime Minister (Korean: 상, Hanja: 相, Romanization: Sang) is 1 star south of the fourth star of the Northern Dipper. It is the prime minister, assisting the Emperor in managing state affairs, the highest administrative official under the monarch, leading all officials and holding military power.

figures.name: Three Excellencies (Gan School)
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Three Excellencies (Korean: 삼공, Hanja: 三公, Romanization: Samgong) consists of 3 stars south of the Northern Dipper's handle. The Three Excellencies include the Grand Commandant, Minister over the Masses, and Minister of Works, the same as the Three Top Instructors, three highly respected official positions.

figures.name: Sombre Lance
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Sombre Lance (Korean: 현과, Hanja: 玄戈, Romanization: Hyeongwa) is 1 star north of the Twinkling Indicator, close to the Celestial Spear and one end of the Northern Dipper. This is a weapon, a halberd, the celestial lance or a weapon used by northern nomadic tribes. It is used to divine whether northern nomadic tribes will invade.

figures.name: Judge for Nobility
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Judge for Nobility (Korean: 천리, Hanja: 天理, Romanization: Cheolli) consists of 4 stars in the Northern Dipper's dipper. It is a prison for nobles and also a law enforcement official.

figures.name: Northern Dipper
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Northern Dipper (Korean: 북두, Hanja: 北斗, Romanization: Bukdu) consists of 7 stars south of the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, corresponds to the Big Dipper in the West. The first 4 stars (α, β, γ, δ UMa) are called Dou Kui (the Bowl or Ladle's Head), and the last 3 stars (ε, ζ, η UMa) are called Dou Bing or Dou Shao (the Handle). Shaped like a ladle and located in the northern sky, it symbolizes the Heavenly Emperor's chariot.

figures.name: Assistant (Vassal of Northern Dipper)
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Assistant (Korean: 보, Hanja: 輔, Romanization: Bo) is 1 star, the prime minister or minister assisting the Northern Dipper.

figures.name: Celestial Spear
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Purple Forbidden Enclosure
figures.story: Celestial Spear (Korean: 천창, Hanja: 天槍, Romanization: Cheonchang) consists of 3 stars east of the Northern Dipper's handle. It is a weapon for defending the Purple Forbidden Enclosure.

figures.name: Supreme Palace
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Supreme Palace Enclosure
figures.story: Supreme Palace Enclosure (Korean: 태미, Hanja: 太微, Romanization: Taemi) is the Heavenly Court where the Heavenly Emperor handles government affairs, mainly composed of various officials. The south gate is called the Meridian Gate.

figures.name: Supreme Palace

figures.story: Supreme Palace, an East Asian star official as identified in Stellarium's Korean sky culture.

figures.name: Usher to the Court
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Supreme Palace Enclosure
figures.story: Usher to the Court (Korean: 알자, Hanja: 謁者, Romanization: Alja) is 1 star north of the Left Law Administrator (η Vir).

figures.name: Inner Seats of Three Excellencies
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Supreme Palace Enclosure
figures.story: Three Excellencies (Korean: 삼공내좌, Hanja: 三公內坐, Romanization: Samgongnaejwa) consists of 3 stars, northeast of the Usher to the Court.

figures.name: Nine Senior Officers
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Supreme Palace Enclosure
figures.story: Nine Senior Officers (Korean: 구경, Hanja: 九卿, Romanization: Gugyeong) consists of 3 stars, north of the Three Excellencies.

figures.name: Five Lords (In Supreme Palace Enclosure)
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Supreme Palace Enclosure
figures.story: Five Lords (Korean: 오제후, Hanja: 五諸侯, Romanization: Ojehu) consists of 5 stars, south of the Officers of the Imperial Guard.

figures.name: Inner Screen
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Supreme Palace Enclosure
figures.story: Inner Screen (Korean: 내병, Hanja: 內屏, Romanization: Naebyeong) consists of 4 stars inside the Meridian Gate, near the south of the Seats of the Five Emperors, close to the Right Law Administrator (β Vir).

figures.name: Five Emperors
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Supreme Palace Enclosure
figures.story: Seats of the Five Emperors (Korean: 오제, Hanja: 五帝, Romanization: Oje) consists of 5 stars in the center of the Supreme Palace Enclosure, the seats of the Five Emperors of the five directions. In the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, there is also the Interior Seats of the Five Emperors. The central bright star (β Leo) is the seat of Yellow Emperor, symbolizing the Son of Heaven.

figures.name: Officer of Honour
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Supreme Palace Enclosure
figures.story: Officer of Honour (Korean: 행신, Hanja: 幸臣, Romanization: Haengsin) is 1 star south of the Crown Prince, northeast of the Seats of the Five Emperors.

figures.name: Crown Prince
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Supreme Palace Enclosure
figures.story: Crown Prince (Korean: 태자, Hanja: 太子, Romanization: Taeja) is 1 star north of the Seat of Yellow Emperor.

figures.name: Retinue (In Supreme Palace Enclosure)
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Supreme Palace Enclosure
figures.story: Retinue (Korean: 종관, Hanja: 從官, Romanization: Jonggwan) is 1 star northwest of the Crown Prince.

figures.name: Captain of the Bodyguards

figures.story: Captain of the Bodyguards (Korean: 낭장, Hanja: 郎將, Romanization: Nangjang) is 1 star northeast of the Officers of the Imperial Guard.

figures.name: Emperor's Bodyguard
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Supreme Palace Enclosure
figures.story: Emperor's Bodyguard (Korean: 호분, Hanja: 虎賁, Romanization: Hobun) is 1 star south of the Lower Step.

figures.name: Royal Guards
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Supreme Palace Enclosure

figures.name: Officers of the Imperial Guard
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Supreme Palace Enclosure
figures.story: Officers of the Imperial Guard (Korean: 낭위, Hanja: 郎位, Romanization: Nangwi) consists of 15 stars, northeast of the Seats of the Five Emperors.

figures.name: The Hall of Glory
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Supreme Palace Enclosure
figures.story: The Hall of Glory (Korean: 명당, Hanja: 明堂, Romanization: Myeongdang) consists of 3 stars outside the southwest corner of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

figures.name: Astronomical Observatory
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Supreme Palace Enclosure
figures.story: Astronomical Observatory (Korean: 영대, Hanja: 靈臺, Romanization: Yeongdae) consists of 3 stars west of the Hall of Glory.

figures.name: Junior Officers
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Supreme Palace Enclosure
figures.story: Junior Officers (Korean: 소미, Hanja: 少微, Romanization: Somi) consists of 4 stars, lined up northwest of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

figures.name: Long Wall
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Supreme Palace Enclosure
figures.story: Long Wall (Korean: 장원, Hanja: 長垣, Romanization: Jangwon) consists of 4 stars south of the Junior Officers.

figures.group: Three Enclosures / Supreme Palace Enclosure
figures.story: Upper Step (Korean: 삼대(상대)(三台(上台)), Romanization: Samdae(Sangdae)) as a part of the Three Steps, consists of 2 stars.

figures.name: Three Steps (Middle Step)
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Supreme Palace Enclosure
figures.story: Middle Step (Korean: 삼대(중대)(三台(中台)), Romanization: Samdae(Jungdae)) as a part of the Three Steps, consists of 2 stars.

figures.story: Three Steps (Korean: 삼대, Hanja: 三台, Romanization: Samdae) consists of 6 stars, the Three Steps start from the Administrative Center and line up in the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

figures.story: Commodity Market (Korean: 거사, Hanja: 車肆, Romanization: Geosa) consists of 2 stars inside the right star of the Heavenly Market Enclosure gate.

figures.story: Official for the Royal Clan (Korean: 종정, Hanja: 宗正, Romanization: Jongjeong) consists of 2 stars southeast of the Emperor's Seat.

figures.story: Textile Ruler (Korean: 백도, Hanja: 帛度, Romanization: Baekdo) consists of 2 stars northeast of the Patriarchal Clan Stars.

figures.name: Butcher's Shops
figures.group: Three Enclosures / Heavenly Market Enclosure
figures.story: Butcher's Shops (Korean: 도사, Hanja: 屠肆, Romanization: Dosa) consists of 2 stars north of the Textile Ruler.

figures.group: Three Enclosures / Heavenly Market Enclosure
figures.story: Astrologer (Korean: 후, Hanja: 候, Romanization: Hu) is 1 star northeast of the Emperor's Seat.

figures.story: Emperor's Seat (Korean: 제좌, Hanja: 帝座, Romanization: Jejwa) is 1 star in the Heavenly Market Enclosure, west of the Astrologer.

figures.story: Jewel Market (Korean: 열사, Hanja: 列肆, Romanization: Yeolsa) consists of 2 stars in the Heavenly Market Enclosure, northwest of the Dipper for Solids.

figures.story: Dipper for Solids (Korean: 곡, Hanja: 斛, Romanization: Gok) consists of 4 stars in the market, south of the Dipper for Liquids.

figures.story: Celestial Cereals (Korean: 직, Hanja: 稷, Romanization: Jik) consists of 5 stars south of the Star mansion.

figures.name: Extended Net
figures.group: Four Symbols / Vermilion Bird of the South / Extended Net Mansion
figures.story: One of the Twenty-Eight Mansions (Extended Net). Extended Net (Korean: 장, Hanja: 張, Romanization: Jang) consists of 6 stars.

figures.name: Celestial Temple
figures.group: Four Symbols / Vermilion Bird of the South / Extended Net Mansion
figures.story: Celestial Temple (Korean: 천묘, Hanja: 天廟, Romanization: Cheonmyo) consists of 14 stars south of the Extended Net.

figures.name: Wings
figures.group: Four Symbols / Vermilion Bird of the South / Wings Mansion
figures.story: One of the Twenty-Eight Mansions (Wings). Wings (Korean: 익, Hanja: 翼, Romanization: Ik) consists of 22 stars.

figures.name: Dongou
figures.group: Four Symbols / Vermilion Bird of the South / Wings Mansion
figures.story: Dong'ou (Korean: 동구, Hanja: 東甌, Romanization: Donggu) consists of 5 stars south of the Wings.

figures.name: Chariot
figures.group: Four Symbols / Vermilion Bird of the South / Chariot Mansion
figures.story: One of the Twenty-Eight Mansions (Chariot). Chariot (Korean: 진, Hanja: 軫, Romanization: Jin) consists of 4 stars.

figures.name: Changsha (Vassal of Chariot)
figures.group: Four Symbols / Vermilion Bird of the South / Chariot Mansion
figures.story: Changsha (Korean: 장사, Hanja: 長沙, Romanization: Jangsa) is 1 star in the Chariot Mansion.

figures.name: Left linchpin (Vassal of Chariot)
figures.group: Four Symbols / Vermilion Bird of the South / Chariot Mansion
figures.story: Left linchpin (Korean: 좌할, Hanja: 左轄, Romanization: Jwahal) consists of 1 star.

figures.name: Right linchpin (Vassal of Chariot)
figures.group: Four Symbols / Vermilion Bird of the South / Chariot Mansion
figures.story: Right linchpin (Korean: 우할, Hanja: 右轄, Romanization: Uhal) consists of 1 star.

figures.name: Military Gate
figures.group: Four Symbols / Vermilion Bird of the South / Chariot Mansion
figures.story: Military Gate (Korean: 군문, Hanja: 軍門, Romanization: Gunmun) consists of 2 stars west of the Green Hill, north of the Master of Constructions.

figures.name: Master of Constructions (In Chariot Mansion)
figures.group: Four Symbols / Vermilion Bird of the South / Chariot Mansion
figures.story: Master of Constructions (Korean: 토사공, Hanja: 土司空, Romanization: Tosagong) consists of 4 stars south of the Military Gate, west of the Green Hill.

figures.name: Green Hill
figures.group: Four Symbols / Vermilion Bird of the South / Chariot Mansion
figures.story: Green Hill (Korean: 청구, Hanja: 青丘, Romanization: Cheonggu) consists of 7 stars southeast of the Chariot.

figures.name: House for Musical Instruments
figures.group: Four Symbols / Vermilion Bird of the South / Chariot Mansion
figures.story: House for Musical Instruments (Korean: 기부, Hanja: 器府, Romanization: Gibu) consists of 32 stars south of the Chariot.
